listing.trademark_check: Legal Desk screen 2026-10-05 (before any art): web searches '"Grandma's Garden" trademark clothing apparel registration', '"grandma's garden" shirt etsy watercolor floral grandma gift' and '"where love grows" trademark clothing USPTO'. Found GRANDMA'S GARDEN & DESIGN registered in Canada for laundry products only (class 3, Grandma's Garden Ltd.), and other GRANDMA'S marks with different wording (GRANDMA'S GANG, cancelled; GRANDMA'S TOUCH; GRANDMA'S BRAT; GRAMPA'S GARDEN APRON, a 2024 filing for aprons). No GRANDMA'S GARDEN apparel, mug or print mark found. First choice 'Cookies at Grandma's' was dropped: GRANDMA'S cookies is a Frito-Lay brand that has sued over 'Grandma' cookie names. Subline 'where love grows' was dropped for LOVE + GROW CLOTHING CO (registered); 'picked with love' is used instead. tmsearch.uspto.gov, Justia and uspto.report pages are blocked from our sessions, so the official database was not searched directly; this is a search-engine screen, not a clearance.
